The issue typically shows up in the Play Console as
```
[split_config.arm64_v8a.apk!libc++_shared.so] pthread.h - std::__ndk1::recursive_mutex::lock()
```
or
```
[split_config.arm64_v8a.apk!libc++_shared.so] std::__ndk1::recursive_mutex::lock()
```

The crashes seem to be reported with "background" visibility.

The crash in `core/input/input.cpp` seems to be on `_THREAD_SAFE_METHOD_`.

I notice other crashes on `_THREAD_SAFE_METHOD_`, e.g. this one with `SceneTree::create_tween()`. Maybe it's a common root cause that `_THREAD_SAFE_METHOD_` can sometimes fail on (some?) Android devices.
